title: Personlig assistent till aktiv 8-årig pojke i Eskilstuna
description: Vi söker en trygg, engagerad och aktiv personlig assistent till en glad och nyfiken 8-årig pojke i Eskilstuna.Arbetet passar dig som tycker om att arbeta med barn, gillar ett aktivt arbete och vill bygga en långsiktig och trygg relation med barnet och familjen.Om barnetHan är en glad, nyfiken och mycket aktiv 8-årig pojke med autism och ADHD. Han tycker om att vara ute, röra på sig och göra olika aktiviteter – särskilt att besöka badhus och simhall.Han går själv men använder ibland rullstol vid vissa aktiviteter utomhus.För att skapa trygghet i vardagen följer han tydliga rutiner och ett välfungerande schema. Som assistent får du en ordentlig introduktion av familjen kring hans behov, rutiner, kommunikation och hur olika situationer bäst hanteras.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom personlig assistent hjälper och stöttar du honom i vardagen. Arbetet innebär bland annat att:    följa med på aktiviteter och utflykter        följa med till badhus/simhall och vara aktiv tillsammans med honom        hjälpa till med personlig hygien och påklädning        hjälpa till vid måltider        förbereda honom inför aktiviteter        följa etablerade rutiner och skapa struktur och trygghet        vara uppmärksam på hans signaler och behovEn viktig del av arbetet är att skapa en trygg och positiv vardag där han får vara så delaktig och självständig som möjligt.Säkerhet och uppmärksamhetHan är mycket aktiv och kan röra sig snabbt. I vissa situationer kan han plötsligt springa iväg, vilket gör att du behöver vara uppmärksam och ha god uppsikt, särskilt vid aktiviteter utanför hemmet.När han blir mycket stressad eller upprörd kan han ibland göra sig själv illa. Därför söker vi en person som kan behålla lugnet, läsa av situationer och arbeta förebyggande.Han är inte aggressiv mot andra.Vem söker vi?Vi söker framför allt rätt person.Du behöver vara:    lugn och tålmodig        trygg och ansvarstagande        uppmärksam och observant        aktiv och ha förmåga att följa med i barnets tempo        lyhörd och respektfull        flexibel och lösningsorienterad        trygg i att arbeta nära både barnet och familjenDu behöver också kunna samarbeta med familjen och förstå betydelsen av kontinuitet och fasta rutiner.ErfarenhetVi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn.Det är särskilt meriterande om du har erfarenhet från exempelvis:    förskola eller barnomsorg        personlig assistans        LSS-verksamhet        boende eller stödverksamhet        arbete med barn med autism, ADHD eller andra neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningarVi värdesätter praktisk erfarenhet, gott omdöme och personlig lämplighet mycket högt.Arbetstid och omfattningArbetet är främst förlagt till eftermiddagar cirka 3–4 dagar per vecka.Under skollov kan även arbetspass på förmiddagar förekomma.Vi söker dig som kan arbeta regelbundet och gärna vill stanna långsiktigt, eftersom kontinuitet och trygghet är mycket viktigt för barnet.Körkort är inget krav. Busskort kan ordnas vid behov.Anställningsform och lön fastställs enligt överenskommelse och tillämpliga villkor.RegisterutdragEftersom arbetet innebär personlig assistans till ett barn kommer registerutdrag för arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning att behöva visas upp i samband med erbjudande om anställning.Låter detta som ett arbete för dig?Om du är en varm, trygg, aktiv och ansvarstagande person som tycker om att arbeta med barn vill vi gärna höra från dig.Berätta gärna kort om dig själv, din tidigare erfarenhet och varför du tror att just du skulle passa för uppdraget.

title: Part-time babysitter in Årsta – Serbian, Bosnian or Croatian speaking
description: Solidum Sverige AB / Barnakademin has been providing families with high-quality childcare services since 2008. title: Bostadsuthyrare för konsultuppdrag i Stockholm
description: Bostadsuthyrare till konsultuppdrag i Stockholm/SolnaVi söker en bostadsuthyrare till ett konsultuppdrag hos ett etablerat bostadsbolag i Stockholm/Solna. Uppdraget är på heltid med start i december och pågår i sex månade med möjlighet till förlängning. Du blir en del av ett team som arbetar med bostadsuthyrning och får en varierad roll med mycket kontakt med hyresgäster.Om uppdragetSom bostadsuthyrare ansvarar du för uthyrning av bostäder, parkeringsplatser och förråd. Du arbetar med hela uthyrningsprocessen, från första kontakt med blivande hyresgäster till avtalsskrivning, besiktning och inflyttning. En viktig del av arbetet är att hålla nere vakanser, ge god service och se till att uthyrningen fungerar effektivt. Du kommer också att arbeta med digitala system och bidra till att utveckla och förbättra arbetssätt. Du utgår från kundens kontor i Stockholm och arbetar både på kontoret och ute i bostadsområdena. Vem söker vi?Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av bostadsuthyrning, är van att arbeta självständigt och trivs med många kontaktytor. Du är strukturerad, serviceinriktad och har lätt för att samarbeta med både kollegor och hyresgäster. Vi söker dig som har:    Gymnasieutbildning    Erfarenhet av bostadsuthyrning, lokaler eller liknande     Erfarenhet av fakturering, avisering och betalningsuppföljning    Kunskaper i hyresjuridik    God systemvana och erfarenhet av fastighetssystem (t.ex. Vitec) är meriterande.    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift    B-körkortAtt arbeta som konsult hos IsakssonDu blir anställd av Isaksson Rekrytering & Bemanning och arbetar som konsult hos vår kund i Stockholm. Vi är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag med kollektivavtal. Som anställd hos oss omfattas du av villkor för lön, semester, försäkringar och pension enligt gällande kollektivavtal. Vi har lång erfarenhet av bemanning inom fastighetsbranschen och håller en nära kontakt med våra konsulter. Under uppdraget har du en kontaktperson hos oss som följer upp hur arbetet fungerar och finns tillgänglig när du behöver stöd.Ansökan och kontaktVarmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår hemsida! Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post.Har du frågor om tjänsten är du varmt välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Frida Lundqvist på 073-526 33 29 eller via e-post på frida@isakssonrekrytering.se (mailto:frida@isakssonrekrytering.se)Isaksson Rekrytering & Bemanning arbetar med rekrytering och bemanning inom fastighet, bygg, infrastruktur, teknik och energi över hela Sverige. Vi är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag med kollektivavtal och har kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö. Läs mer på www.isakssonrekrytering.se (http://www.isakssonrekrytering.se/).

Vi är lyhörda för dina behov och du kommer att ha en nära relation med din konsultchef som stöttar dig i din utveckling. #Bildlänkhttps://media.sjr.se/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/konsult_interim_annons_23.png

title: SAP Solution Architect
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Is the feeling of having a meaningful job something you like? Would you like to share your thoughts and knowledge to enable growth and profitability? Do you want tho work with ERP services globally? Then this just might be the right challenge for you as we are looking for new team members to our SAP SAP team. We have a multi ERP strategy within Epiroc and one of our global managed ERP applications is SAP. Our current SAP installation consist of 4 different SAP ERP solutions that is used by 20 customer centers and 2 productions centers. We have started the cloud journey of upgrade one of our installations for the customer center to the SAP S4HANA. The upgrade will let our business to be able to utilise the latest functionality provided from the SAP application. We are therefore looking for strengthening the team with SAP Solution Architect. We work in an open and friendly way, where we support each other to ensure we provide the best possible solutions for our users. We complement each other with a broad knowledge, and we make sure to have fun at work. Within Epiroc IT so have we started the transformation to an agile working model.   Your Mission As SAP Solution Architect, you will design and govern SAP solutions that align with business strategy while ensuring scalable, future-proof architecture. You will translate business requirements into SAP functional and technical designs. Ensure integration across SAP modules and surrounding systems. Standardization and template based delivery is important factors for the SAP environment. You should be updated on new technology and functionality that can improve the solution.Profile description:Your profileYou have an experience within SAP ERP Solutions. You have a University Degree or similar knowledge gained through work experience. Experience with leading teams is beneficial.   You have more than 4 years of experience within an IT area in an international company. As for your personal skills we are looking for someone who is goal orientated, fast learner and eager to learn along the way. You are able to adopt new technologies and tools when needed, open-minded to enjoy intellectual sparring and knowledge sharing. The job requires a lot of collaboration both internally and externally so good interpersonal and communications skills are a prerequisite to be successful in the role. We also expect you to have good analytical and administration skills. Location and travel The location is preferable at one of our Epiroc IT hubs, located in Örebro or Stockholm, (Sweden), Prague, (Czech Republic).   International travel will be part of the role. Application and contactsIn this recruitment process we review applications continuously and we may close the process before the last application day. A hybrid workplace Life at Epiroc can include the possibility for a hybrid workplace. It is a way of working that offers flexibility and participation allowing for a better balance between work and private life, which also promotes well-being. At the same time, we value in-person collaboration and team connection. Therefore, we expect our employees to be present in the office at least three days per week, with flexibility for remote work during the remaining working days, depending on business needs and role requirements.

title: Cloud / Platform Engineer  Infrastructure and Cloud Migration - 20812
description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an experienced Cloud / Platform Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on cloud infrastructure, networking, and service migration. The assignment is intended for an engineer with substantial hands-on expertise in complex infrastructure environments and established cloud platforms.This is a dedicated infrastructure role rather than a traditional Platform Engineering position combining infrastructure and backend development. A central part of the mission is to support the migration of existing services to a new European cloud environment.Key Responsibilities    Design, configure, and improve cloud infrastructure with a particular focus on networking, Kubernetes, and Terraform.    Provide hands-on technical expertise across established cloud platforms and complex infrastructure environments.    Support the infrastructure-related aspects of migrating services to a new European cloud environment.    Analyze existing services and define infrastructure solutions that enable secure and practical migration.    Contribute to technical decisions, architecture discussions, and solution design relating to cloud infrastructure.    Translate technical infrastructure requirements into pragmatic, implementable solutions.    Rapidly understand the existing technical environment and deliver results within a time-limited assignment.Technical Stack & Requirements    Networking: Substantial technical expertise in cloud and infrastructure networking.    Kubernetes: Strong practical experience operating and supporting Kubernetes environments.    Terraform: Strong hands-on experience provisioning and managing infrastructure as code.    Cloud platforms: Experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, OpenStack, or an equivalent environment.    Multi-cloud: Experience working across multiple cloud platforms and adapting infrastructure solutions accordingly.    T-Cloud: Previous hands-on experience is advantageous, particularly in relation to cloud infrastructure and migration activities.Qualifications & ExperienceThe successful consultant will have a strong technical background in cloud infrastructure and practical experience analyzing complex infrastructure challenges. The role requires the ability to make sound technical decisions, produce feasible solution designs, and work independently in unfamiliar environments. A structured and pragmatic engineering approach is important, as is the ability to become productive quickly and generate tangible results during a time-limited engagement.

title: Global Demand Planner Nouryon
description: We are looking for a Demand Planner who combines strong analytical skills with a collaborative and business-oriented mindset. You will turn data, market insights and commercial input into reliable demand plans that help us improve availability, forecasting and supply chain performance. Does that sound like you? About the jobAs Demand Planner you will play a key role in our business planning process, creating and continuously improving a robust 24-month demand plan for your area.You will work at the intersection of Sales, Customer Service and Supply Chain, combining statistical forecasting with commercial and market insights to balance customer demand, product availability and operational efficiency.Please note: We apply continuous selection, so the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. In your future role as Global Demand Planner you will    Develop, analyze and maintain a rolling 24-month demand forecast, combining statistical forecasting, historical demand, commercial input and market insights.    Partner closely with Sales Managers, Customer Service and Supply Chain teams to align assumptions, manage exceptions and ensure anticipated market developments and commercial strategies are reflected in the demand plan.    Monitor forecast performance and demand management KPIs, identify forecast errors and trends, and translate your analysis into corrective actions and continuous improvements.    Perform forecast segmentation and maintain appropriate statistical forecasting models in Arkieva, ensuring products and new product/plant combinations are assigned relevant forecasting approaches.    Support and facilitate Global Demand Reviews and contribute to Supply Management and Demand Supply Reviews, including inventory strategies, new product introductions and product phase-outs.    Drive improvements in planning processes, tools and ways of working and contribute to Supply Chain and demand management projects. We believe you bring    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Business or a related discipline OR equivalent relevant experience.    Solid understanding of supply chain and business planning processes, combined with strong analytical capabilities.    Demonstrated ability to work with large and complex datasets, including data validation, trend analysis and forecasting.    Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and confidence working with digital planning and data environments.    Very good communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels.    A structured and results-oriented approach, with the ability to prioritize, take initiative and move work forward with limited direction. Great if you have    Experience with SAP or another ERP system, Business Warehouse or another data warehouse, and Arkieva or comparable advanced planning software.    Experience with statistical forecasting, demand planning or Integrated Business Planning processes.    APICS CPIM or CSCP certification. We believe you areYou enjoy combining analytical thinking with collaboration and know how to turn complex information into clear conclusions and actions. You build productive relationships across functions and communicate confidently with stakeholders at different levels of the organization.You take ownership of your work, set priorities and proactively move topics forward. At the same time, you are curious about how processes can be improved and comfortable challenging existing ways of working when data points to a better solution. We offer youThis is an opportunity to take an important role in Nouryon’s regional planning process and work in a collaborative, international environment. You will have broad interaction across Sales, Customer Service and Supply Chain and the opportunity to influence both day-to-day planning performance and longer-term improvements in our processes and tools.At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary. [Insert location-specific collective agreement and benefits.] Have we got your interest?This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, reporting to the Business Planning Manager and based in Gothenburg.Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/As an applicant, you will be subject to a background check before employment. You will receive more information about this later in the recruitment process. We work actively and systematically with HSE matters to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. As an employee, you may therefore be required to undergo drug testing on a random basis. This is part of our commitment to safeguarding the safety and well-being of our staff. We look forward to receiving your application! About NouryonExplore careers and life at NouryonIf you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn.ContactFor additional information about the vacancy, please contact Anna Gradin. Business Planning Manager, anna.gradin@nouryon.comIf you have any questions about the recruitment process or your application or need assistance, please contact: Recruiting.SE@Nouryon.comFor union-related inquiries:Akademikerklubben: Katarina Risö – katarina.riso@nouryon.comUnionen: Helene Rosenlund –helene.rosenlund@nouryon.com Ledarna: Sanna Backman – sanna.backman@nouryon.com #WeAreNouryon #GrowWithUs

title: Electronics Lab Technician  Husqvarna Group
description: Do you enjoy hands-on electronics work and turning ideas into working prototypes?You will join our Technology team, a group of around 20 colleagues working with electronics for our robotic lawn mowers. The team brings together a mix of employees and consultants with expertise across hardware development, detailed electronics design, test development, lab activities, and supporting engineering systems.It is a collaborative and practical environment where you will work closely with hardware engineers and other specialists throughout the development process.Role Description:In this role, you will be part of our Lab & Test team, supporting our electronics development with practical lab work. You will work closely with hardware engineers and other colleagues across the team, helping them modify circuit boards, build prototypes and prepare electronics for development and testing. Your main tasks will include:    Responsible for maintaining and supporting the soldering lab.    Advanced soldering, including manual SMD rework on PCBAs    Modifying and troubleshooting electronic assemblies    Building electronic and electromechanical prototypes    Supporting engineers with practical electronics and lab activities    Working according to ESD and EPA requirementsYour profileWe believe you have a practical background in electronics, for example from electronics manufacturing, EMS, electronics production or a similar environment. You are comfortable working hands-on with circuit boards and electronic components and have a good general understanding of electronics and electromechanical circuits. You have:    Around 3-4 years of relevant experience, particularly if you have worked extensively with soldering and electronics service    Strong skills in manual soldering and SMD rework    Good knowledge of ESD and EPA practices    Good communication skills in Swedish and EnglishExperience with 3D modelling and 3D printing and knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC-7711, or similar soldering standards is a plus.This is an on-site role, where access to the electronics lab and close collaboration with the team are an important part of the everyday work.LocationHuskvarna. We believe the best ideas happen when we are connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive.Your applicationPlease apply with CV and Cover Letter. We do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For more questions regarding the position please contact: Hiring Manager: Fredrik Huus. fredrik.huus@husqvarnagroup.com.  For more information about the recruitment process, please contact: Recruiter: Gorjana Dubovina,gorjana.dubovina@husqvarnagroup.com.Processing of personal dataWhen you send in your application we will process your personal data. In case we choose to proceed with your application, we may ask you to verify your identity before giving you a job offer. For more information about how we process your personal data, who we may share it with and what rights you have, please see our privacy notice.Winning Through Culture We believe that business is ultimately about people, as a team, we win and grow together. Our culture is built on bold ideas, strong commitment, and a shared purpose, creating an environment where innovation thrives, people grow, and every contribution matters.Our culture is built on three core themes:     Bold: We push boundaries, embrace challenges, and explore new possibilities.    Dedicated: We put in the hard work, bring passion and resilience to every challenge we take on.    Care: We support each other, consider the impact of our actions, and strive to make a lasting difference. Whether you’re starting your career or looking for the next big step, we offer a place where passion and purpose come together. Join us in shaping the future! Learn more about our culture here.

title: Data Platform Administrator
description: ComeOn Group in ShortComeOn Group in short Founded in 2008, ComeOn Group is a leading global player in the rapidly growing iGaming market. Having launched its first online brand in 2010, ComeOn Group is running a wide range of exciting brands across multiple markets. Operating more than 20 brands on its proprietary platform providing a secure, innovative and entertainment-led player experience across casino and sports betting. ComeOn Group is an international employer within the iGaming industry and has over 500 talented employees across 7 main locations.Location: Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid) or Katowice, PolandComeOn Group is a data-driven company, and our Data Platform Engineering & Operations team is critical to enabling business success. We are seeking a technically strong Data Platform Administrator with deep operational expertise, someone confident in managing MySQL and MongoDB across all environments. You will be responsible for platform uptime, schema changes, performance optimization and managing large-scale data operations and migrations. This role combines hands-on operational work with growth into broader data engineering responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence platform reliability, support analytics and drive key projects across the organization.Responsibilities:    Own MySQL, MongoDB and related systems across development and production environments.    Ensure database uptime, reliability, performance tuning, monitoring, scaling, backups and security.    Manage schema changes, large-table operations, and data migrations with confidence and precision.    Lead database upgrades and work with teams to refactor legacy structures into modern, scalable designs.    Automate operational tasks to increase efficiency and reliability.    Support real-time pipelines and data flows across teams.    Support audits, change management and regulatory compliance.    Manage access controls and release processes.    Partner with developers, product owners, BI teams and QA to ensure high-quality, reliable data.    Collaborate with the team and grow into broader engineering responsibilities over time.About you:    5+ years of experience in MySQL and MongoDB administration.    Experience with schema changes, large-table operations, performance tuning and migrations.    Strong operational mindset: high-availability setups, backups and platform reliability.    Comfortable in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.    Exposure to cloud platforms (BigQuery, AWS, GCP).    Scripting/automation experience (Python, Bash, SQL). Proactive, confident and ready to take ownership.    Collaborates effectively with developers, product owners, BI teams, QA and DevOps.    Eager to modernize legacy database structures and expand into broader data engineering responsibilities, including understanding modern dataflow tooling and pipelines.    Proficient in English, both spoken and written.BenefitsSo what can you expect from ComeOn as a place of work? Benefits:    A competitive remuneration package inc. a company bonus scheme! 💰    Fantastic quarterly team events and weekly company events 😎    A one-time bonus to help you set up a comfortable workstation at home (we’re truly Hybrid!)    On top of our Hybrid work arrangement, up to 40 days a year to work fully remote from anywhere 🌎    Brand new laptop and smartphone with fully paid plan    Company events, including breakfast mornings and Friday beers At ComeOn, we have adapted a Hybrid Work model which means that we offer our employees an option to pick their workstation for the day. Want to work from the office a few days a week and some days from home? That’s totally fine with us! ComeOn is known for their inviting and vibrant offices that offer creative areas for collaboration and desk set-ups designed for a Hybrid Work model. When you visit one of our offices you will always be welcomed by a friendly face that will take good care of you. It’s our curiosity that drives our innovative business forward and we work hard in a run together spirit and we always make sure to top it up by having fun! You will not regret picking ComeOn as your next place of work. At ComeOn Group we value diversity and we take concrete action to ensure fairness in our recruitment process. We are committed to assess candidates on their merit without discriminating against any applicant for whatever reason that is protected by law. We truly value you, as you are. Want to know more about us? Just visit our website www.comeon-group.com or any of our social media channels to take a deep dive into our culture!

title: Product Owner - AI & Test Engineering
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – AI & Test Engineering to join our SW Platform organization. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role, AI is at the heart of what you do. You’ll help shape how software developers across all of Epiroc use AI in their daily work, and how AI changes the way we test and verify our software. Are you curious about how AI is changing software development? Do you enjoy collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Would you like to help build something new from the start, with an impact across the whole company? Then we’d love to hear from you. A stream in the making AI & Test Engineering is a new product stream in our platform organisation. The teams are being built right now, and their setup, size and exact scope aren’t finalised yet. As Product Owner, you’ll have a real opportunity to influence how the stream takes shape, together with the teams, your manager and the Chief Product Owner. Your mission As Product Owner you’re responsible for the AI & Test Engineering product stream, where AI is the main focus. The stream is planned to cover two areas:     AI Software Factory: exploring and introducing AI-supported, agentic ways of working across the software development lifecycle, for all software developers at Epiroc.     AI-driven Test & Integration: using AI to rethink how we test and integrate platform software, together with test frameworks, simulation, a software-defined lab and system testing. You connect the teams with their stakeholders. For the AI Software Factory, these are software developers and development teams across Epiroc’s divisions and sites. For Test & Integration, they are mainly the internal teams that develop and deliver on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value. You keep up with how AI in software development is evolving and help turn new possibilities into practical value for developers and testers. You work closely with the Scrum Masters and Tech Leads, collaborate with our architects and work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap. You also take part in cross-team planning together with the other product streams. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.Profile description:Your profile     You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, test lead, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.     You have a genuine interest in AI and how it can support software development and testing, and you may already use AI tools in your own work.     You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.     You enjoy working with a broad range of stakeholders and helping new ways of working spread across an organization.     It’s a plus if you have experience with AI-assisted or agentic software development, AI in testing, test automation, CI/CD or simulation.     You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken. As a person, you’re curious, structured, communicative and collaborative. You’re comfortable when not everything is decided yet, and you enjoy helping to create structure together with others. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and like to keep learning. We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products. Location The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office. Application and contacts Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

title: Chief Product Owner
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description: Are you passionate about shaping the direction of complex products and bringing people, technology and customer needs together? As Chief Product Owner, you will have the opportunity to influence the future of our Platform organization, creating a shared direction across teams and helping ensure that hardware and software evolve together as one connected product ecosystem. This is a strategic role for someone who enjoys seeing the bigger picture, building alignment and turning complexity into clear priorities. Your mission As Chief Product Owner, you will shape the overarching product vision and roadmap across multiple product areas and development teams. Working closely with Product Owners, Product Line Owners and cross-functional teams, you will translate business objectives and customer needs into clear priorities, major features and epics. An important part of your mission will be to develop our approach to Agile at scale, creating common ways of working and collaborative planning through forums such as Big Room Planning. Within Platform, you will also bring hardware and software development closer together, helping teams navigate dependencies and align priorities and deliveries. By connecting engineering, product management, marketing, sales and senior management, you will create clarity around where we are going, why it matters and how we succeed together. Profile description:Your profile You have a strong background in product ownership, product management or strategic product leadership, preferably from a complex technical or industrial environment. You are comfortable working across several teams or product areas and understand how customer needs and business priorities can be translated into a clear product strategy and roadmap. Experience with Agile ways of working at scale, cross-functional planning and managing dependencies between teams will help you succeed in the role. Experience with Big Room Planning or similar approaches, as well as working with products that combine hardware and software, is valuable but does not need to come from one specific industry. Equally important is your ability to listen, bring different perspectives together and create alignment in a collaborative way. You communicate with clarity, approach complexity with curiosity and structure, and are comfortable making thoughtful decisions while keeping customer value and shared goals in focus. Location The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office. Application and contacts Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

title: Product Owner - Machine Foundation
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:We’re looking for a Product Owner – Machine Foundation to join our SW Platform organisation. We’re responsible for the machine platform that Epiroc’s mining and construction equipment runs on. In this role you’ll help shape the core software that every machine application relies on, from our Linux-based operating system to the base functionality and middleware that support it. Do you enjoy working close to technology, collaborating with people across teams and helping turn needs into clear priorities? Then we’d love to hear from you. Your mission As Product Owner you’re responsible for the Machine Foundation product stream. You work with two agile development teams:     OS team: develops our Linux-based operating system, including the service OS and secure boot.     Base & Middleware team: works with base functionality and middleware that support the applications running on our machines. You connect the teams with their stakeholders, mainly the internal teams that build on the platform. You’re responsible for the product backlog in Jira and the roadmap, and you shape what goes into the OS. By listening to stakeholders and understanding their needs, you help translate them into clear epics and user stories and support the teams in focusing on what creates the most value. You work closely with each team’s Scrum Master and Tech Lead, and you collaborate with our architects in the direction of the base and middleware areas. You work closely with the Chief Product Owner on the overall platform roadmap, take part in cross-team planning and contribute to release go/no-go decisions. Each team has about 5–8 members. You’ll report to a team manager in the SW Platform organization and be part of a supportive team where knowledge sharing and learning are encouraged.Profile description:Your profile     You have experience as a Product Owner or in a similar role, for example product manager, technical project lead or requirements owner, in a software development environment.     You’re familiar with agile ways of working such as Scrum and with tools like Jira.     You have an interest in software development and enjoy discussions with developers and architects.     It’s a plus if you have experience with embedded Linux, operating systems, middleware or platform software, for example in industrial, automotive or similar products.     You speak Swedish and you’re fluent in English, both written and spoken. As a person, you’re structured, communicative and collaborative. You build trusting relationships with stakeholders, help the teams find focus and handle different perspectives with care. You enjoy working with people as much as with technology and like to keep learning together with others. We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If this role sounds interesting, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We welcome applicants of all genders and backgrounds and believe diverse teams build better products. Location The role is based in Örebro, Sweden. We work hybrid, with at least three days a week in the office. Application and contacts Please send your application, including CV and personal letter, by creating an account in our recruitment system as soon as possible but no later than 27th of November. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date. Please note that, due to the current regulations, we will only consider applications received through our system and not via email or social media.

title: Lead Engineer Plants HVDC
description: The OpportunityWe are looking for a Lead Engineer - Plants who wants to take on a key role at HVDC in technical leadership in tenders and projects. You will have the responsibility to coordinate global teams with focus on Plants and Civil engineering design solutions and its interfaces for our onshore and offshore converter stations.  As a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will drive strategic technical decision making, ensure that our design solutions meet customer requirements, quality standards and project goals. You interact with other stakeholders such as customers, contractors, supply chain and site team, contributing to the successful delivery of some of the world's most advanced energy infrastructure projects. The role is offering a unique opportunity to contribute to the global energy transition while working in a highly collaborative and international environment. This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden."Are you ready to become part of a group of technical leaders with a passion for supporting our engineering teams and driving them forward? We work closely with many different functions and as a Lead Engineer - Plants, you will play a key role in driving transparency around technical solutions and their impact on projects that contribute to a greener future."– Kamilla Sommarsjö, Global Head HVDC Lead Engineers - PlantsHow You'll Make an Impact    Provide strong technical leadership across Plants and Civil engineering teams and their interfaces.    Primary contact for technical communication with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.    Drive completion of engineering activities in tenders and projects, working closely with technical leads, project managers, and interface managers.    Manage technical risks and ensure compliance with quality, safety and engineering processes.    Support installation and commissioning activities by providing expert technical guidance.    Lead development of new technical solutions while interpreting customer’s needs and expectations.    Take a strategic role in defining Plants and Civil solutions for onshore HVDC converter stations and offshore platforms.    Coordinate engineering activities across key disciplines, including:    Electromechanical Design    Station Auxiliary Power Systems    Civil Engineering    Auxiliary Systems (eg Fire Protection, HVAC, Security Systems)    Ensure effective coordination and management of interfaces between engineering disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.    Represent the Plants discipline in customer meetings, partner discussions, and technical reviews.Your Background    Academic degree in Engineering (for example within Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related area)    At least 5 years of engineering experience, including experience of leading technical teams, multidisciplinary engineering activities or complex projects is required.    Experience within HVDC, transmission systems, substations, electrical power systems, offshore wind, or other large-scale energy infrastructure projects is highly valued.    Strong technical understanding with the ability to quickly develop expertise in HVDC technology and systems.    A collaborative and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to build trust and influence stakeholders across functions and geographic locations.    Strong leadership skills and the confidence to make technical decisions when required.    Excellent communication skills and the ability to present technical solutions in a clear and structured manner.    Fluency in English, both verbally and written, is required. Other languages are an advantage.As a person, you are passionate about both people and technology. You thrive in a dynamic environment, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are motivated by solving complex technical challenges together with others.More About Us​We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​    Health care and wellness allowance ​    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​    Psychological support program ​    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Malin Johansson, malin.johansson@hitachienergy.com​Union representatives: Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86, Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 43, Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85

title: Family Assistant in Lidingö, Stockholm
description: Connecting Jobs, run by the non-profit organization Beredskapslyftet, supports newcomers in taking their first steps into the Swedish labour market – while at the same time helping employers access new talent.We are now looking for family assistant. In this role, you will support one of the company’s owner with everyday practical tasks. The role is varied and hands-on, ranging from errands and transport to dog walks.Location:Stockholm and Lidingö areaWho we are looking for:Family AssistantResponsibilities:    Doing shopping, picking up and dropping off goods, and running daily errands    Driving and handling transport as needed    Walking the dogs when needed    Helping with simple practical tasks and keeping things in orderRequirements:    You have a very good command of English, conversational Swedish is preferred    You can understand instructions and communicate clearly in Swedish or English    You have a B driving licence valid in Sweden and feel confident driving    You love dogs and feel comfortable handling them. You are physically able to take longer dog walks in all kinds of weather    You are energetic, quick and proactive, and you enjoy an active working day    You are punctual, careful and responsible    You are reliable and service-mindedWhat the employer offers:    Full-time job (100%) with the possibility of long-term employment    Standard working hours, Monday–Friday, daytime    Start date to be discussed    Salary and benefits to be discussed during the interviewImportant: This position is part of a project that is co-funded by the European Union through the Asylum, Migration and Integration Fund (AMIF). The project aims to support third-country nationals in their integration into the Swedish labor market. The participants hold residence permits in Sweden but do not have Swedish citizenship or EU/EEA citizenship.

title: Lead Architect inom Identity & Access Management (IAM)
description: För kunds räkning söker vi nu en Lead Architect inom Identity & Access Management (IAM). Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.Om tjänsten:I rollen som Lead Architect / IAM Arkitekt arbetar du både taktiskt och strategiskt med att hålla ihop, driva och utveckla tjänster inom IAM-området tillsammans med flertalet duktiga kollegor.Du ansvarar för att leda och koordinera teamet genom mentorskap, samarbete och utveckling. IT-lösningar ska realiseras på ett korrekt sätt i enlighet med regulatoriska krav, verksamhetens behov samt i relation till andra IT-lösningar. Du prioriterar backloggen och stöttar gruppen genom ett tydligt ledarskap.I rollen säkerställer du att företagsövergripande arkitekturprinciper och riktlinjer kring standarder följs i den tekniska arkitekturen. Du gör medvetna arkitekturval för att skapa maximalt värde för verksamheten. Teamets fokus ligger på identitetssäkerhet och cybersäkerhet, regelefterlevnad, behörighetskontroll och livscykelhantering – områden där du har ett övergripande ansvar.Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:    Stötta och leda teamet    Leda dig själv och hjälpa andra att navigera i en snabbrörlig och stundtals oförutsägbar omvärld (VUCA)    Agera sakkunnig och stötta Head of Service Area, Service Managers och Service Owners    Ta fram beslutsunderlag för både affärsmässiga beslut och tekniska vägval    Säkerställa att krav, regler, lagar, processer, standarder och policyer efterlevs    Designa lösningsförslag ur olika perspektiv    Dokumentera lösningar och arkitektur    Presentera och kommunicera lösningar för olika målgrupper och i olika forum    Använda agila metoder för att koordinera och leda arbetetDin profil:För att trivas i rollen och möta förväntningarna ser vi att du har flera års erfarenhet som arkitekt inom IAM-området. Erfarenhet från globala och mer komplexa organisationer är meriterande.Som person är du positiv, lösningsorienterad och trivs i en dynamisk miljö där ingen dag är den andra lik. Du kommunicerar effektivt med målgrupper på olika tekniska nivåer och har starka presentationstekniker. Du har en stöttande personlighet där mentorskap, samarbete och utveckling är centrala drivkrafter.Kvalifikationer:För att vara relevant för rollen har du erfarenhet och djup kompetens inom ett eller flera av följande områden:    Privileged Access Security    Access Management och PAM    Identity Governance och Life-cycle Management    Policy enforcement och policy decision (PBAC, RBAC, ABAC)    Identity Federation och SSO (modern, traditionell, hybrid och public cloud)    Zero Trust / Zero Trust Network Access    API Security    Regulatoriska krav såsom NIST och Export Control    Foundation Data    PKI    MFA    Erfarenhet av Enterprise Architecture (Business, IT och Solution Architecture)    Förmåga att förmedla Enterprise Architecture-visionen till IAM-domänarkitektur    Visualisering och kommunikation av arkitekturer och transitionsarkitekturer    Stakeholder-hantering ur ett arkitekturperspektiv    Erfarenhet av att implementera och dokumentera domänarkitektur i stora organisationer.För kunds räkning söker vi nu en IT Solution Architect till avdelningen Special Purpose Environments. Är du en engagerad och lösningsorienterad person som vill vara med och designa och realisera IT-lösningar som skapar värde och efterlever regulatoriska krav? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!Ytterligare information:Location: MalmöI rollen kan resor inom Sverige förekomma.Detta är en projektanställning hos NXT Interim Malmö AB. Vi tillämpar kollektivavtal. Detta är en konsultroll med placering i en försvarshemlig miljö, vilket ställer höga krav på säkerhet och integritet. Säkerhetsprövning är ett krav för denna tjänst, och du måste vara svensk medborgare för att kvalificera dig.Kunden erbjuder:För kunds räkning erbjuder vi en dynamisk och innovativ arbetsmiljö där du får möjlighet att utvecklas och bidra med din expertis. Här får du arbeta med spännande projekt och lösningar som gör skillnad för verksamheten.Låter detta som ett intressant uppdrag?Sök redan idag! Vi behöver din ansökan, inkluderat CV, på svenska. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan då anbudstiden är kort.NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag inom konsult- och rekryteringsbranschen. Vi arbetar inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter förmåner som sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller vardagen.

title: Vikarier till äldreboende i Nacka | Jul- och nyårsvikariat
description: Vill du bidra till en trygg, värdig och meningsfull vardag för våra boende under jul- och nyårsperioden?Vi söker dig som studerar inom vård och omsorg, har erfarenhet av  arbete inom vård och omsorg eller vill ta dina första steg inom äldreomsorgen. Hos oss får du arbeta i en verksamhet där kvalitet, personcentrerad omsorg och gott bemötande står i fokus.Erfarenhet är meriterande, men det viktigaste är att du har ett genuint intresse för människor och en vilja att göra skillnad.Ditt uppdragNacka seniorcenter består av fyra verksamheter i Finntorp, Ektorp, Saltsjöbaden och Saltsjö-Boo. Här erbjuder vi särskilt boende med fokus på god omsorg, sociala aktiviteter och hemlagad mat.Som vårdbiträde arbetar du nära kunder, anhöriga och kollegor med utgångspunkt i individens behov, önskemål och förutsättningar. Du bidrar aktivt till att skapa trygghet, delaktighet och livskvalitet för de människor som bor hos oss.I rollen ger du omsorg och stöd i vardagen, medverkar vid måltider och aktiviteter, arbetar personcentrerat, samverkar med kollegor och dokumenterar enligt verksamhetens rutiner.Arbetet innebär ett stort eget ansvar samtidigt som du är en viktig del av ett engagerat team där samarbete, omtanke och kvalitet är avgörande.ArbetstidFör att vara aktuell för tjänsten behöver du kunna arbeta flexibelt utifrån verksamhetens schemabehov. Arbetet är förlagt till dag-, kvälls- och helgpass enligt schema mellan kl. 07.00 och 21.00. Vi söker dig som är intresserad av ett långsiktigt vikariat under jul, nyår och som gärna fortsätter hos oss även under sommaren. För dig som vill finns möjlighet att arbeta som timvikarie både före och efter vikariatet. Vi ser gärna att du kan arbeta cirka 10 pass per månad och är flexibel utifrån verksamhetens behov. Din erfarenhetKrav    Fyllt 18 år    Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift    Grundläggande datorvanaMeriterande    Påbörjad utbildning som vårdbiträde eller undersköterska    Erfarenhet av arbete inom äldreomsorg, omsorg eller serviceyrken    Erfarenhet av arbete med personer med demenssjukdom    Erfarenhet av dokumentation    Erfarenhet av vård- och omsorgsarbete    Erfarenhet av delegerade hälso- och sjukvårdsinsatserÄr det här du?Vi söker dig som vill göra skillnad för andra människor och bidra till en trygg och meningsfull vardag för våra boende.Du är ansvarstagande, samarbetsorienterad och bemöter boende, anhöriga och kollegor med respekt och omtanke. Du är flexibel, tar initiativ och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.Tidigare erfarenhet av vård och omsorg är meriterande, men det viktigaste är ditt engagemang, din vilja att lära och ditt intresse för människor.Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.Vi erbjuderNacka seniorcenter är det kommunala alternativet för äldreomsorg i Nacka kommun med verksamheter i Ektorp, Finntorp, Saltsjöbaden och Saltsjö-Boo.Som vikarie anställs du av Stab kompetensförsörjning som ansvarar för bemanningen vid kort- och långtidsfrånvaro. Du kan arbeta på en eller flera verksamheter beroende på behov och tillgänglighet.För att skapa kontinuitet i verksamheten ser vi gärna att du kan arbeta cirka 10 pass per månad. Vi söker dig som vill bygga en långsiktig relation med oss och som är intresserad av att fortsätta arbeta under sommaren.Utdrag från Polisens belastningsregisterI Nacka kommun krävs utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister för arbete inom äldreomsorgen i samband med anställning. Vi ber dig välja digitalt registerutdrag för snabbare hantering.Begär gärna utdraget i samband med att du skickar in din ansökan eftersom handläggningstiderna kan variera.Intresserad?Vill du bli en del av Nacka kommun? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!Tjänsterna avser vikariat under jul- och nyårsperioden utifrån verksamheternas behov, med möjlighet till förlängning. För att säkerställa en god introduktion inleds anställningen som timanställning. Vikariat erbjuds när introduktionen är genomförd och godkänd av både medarbetaren och verksamheten.Vi rekryterar utan personligt brev och ber dig i stället besvara urvalsfrågorna i samband med din ansökan. Bedömningen görs utifrån ditt CV och dina svar. Urval sker löpande och rekryteringsprocessen inkluderar gruppintervju och referenstagning.Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Mechanical Design Manager for External Design
description: The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Power Transformers in Ludvika, we develop and deliver some of the world's most advanced transformers, supporting the global transition to a more sustainable energy system.We are now looking for a Mechanical Design Manager to lead our External Design team. In this role, you will be responsible for a group of highly skilled engineers working with customer-driven projects in close collaboration with production, project management, quality, supply chain, and customers around the world.This is a people-focused leadership role where success is built through trust, collaboration, technical excellence, and long-term competence development. You will lead an experienced team, support individual growth, and create conditions for engineers to perform their best while delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.As part of the Power Transformers Engineering Management Team, you will contribute to the continued development of our engineering organization and help shape how we work, grow, and succeed together.Ludvika has been at the center of power transmission innovation for more than a century. Here, you will combine local teamwork and long-term relationships with the opportunity to contribute to projects that support energy transition on a global scale.How you’ll make an impact    Lead, coach, and develop a team of 15–20 mechanical engineers.    Foster a culture built on collaboration, ownership, safety, and continuous learning.    Support competence development and long-term succession planning within the team.    Work closely with project management, production, quality, and other engineering functions to ensure successful project execution.    Drive continuous improvements in ways of working, quality, and operational performance.    Balance customer requirements, business priorities, and sound engineering judgement.    Contribute to the strategic development of the Mechanical Design organization.    Create an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and challenged to growYour background    You hold a degree in Engineering or have gained equivalent knowledge through substantial experience in a technical field.    You have experience from engineering, product development, manufacturing, project execution, or another industrial environment.    Previous leadership experience is beneficial but not required. We are equally interested in experienced leaders and strong technical professionals ready to take the next step.    Experience from transformers, power systems, heavy industry, manufacturing, mechanical design, or related technical fields is an advantage.    You enjoy working with people and understanding how to build engagement, trust, and high-performing teams.    You are comfortable balancing day-to-day operational needs with longer-term strategic objectives.    You communicate effectively with engineers, specialists, project managers, production teams, customers, and senior stakeholders.    You are fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.More About Us​We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:  ​    Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​    Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​    Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​    Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​    Health care and wellness allowance ​    Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction) ​    Psychological support program ​    Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​    Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​    Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​    Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations. ​Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today. ​Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.com​Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Håkan Blomquist, hkan.blomquist@hitachienergy.com ; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, frank.hollstedt@hitachienergy.com ; Unionen: Olle Ruzicka, olle.ruzicka@hitachienergy.com

title: Scientist
description: Are you passionate about protein analytics and scientific problem-solving? Would you like to contribute to the development of innovative injectable products in a global, science-driven organization? We are looking for a Scientist to join our Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry team within Injectables Development in Uppsala.In this role, you will contribute to the development and validation of analytical methods that support the advancement of new products and technologies. Working in a collaborative and highly skilled environment, you will help generate the scientific insights that drive innovation and ensure product quality throughout development.This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing organization where your expertise will contribute directly to the future of injectable aesthetics.Make your mark. Grow with us.  Your team Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry is part of Galderma's Injectables Development organization in Uppsala. The team provides analytical expertise that supports the development of innovative products and technologies, helping to strengthen and expand Galderma's portfolio.You will join a collaborative and highly engaged team where knowledge sharing, scientific curiosity, and mutual support are valued. Together, we work in a dynamic environment where quality, innovation, and patient focus guide everything we do. Your missionAs a Scientist within Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry, you will plan, perform, and interpret analytical studies supporting product and process development. You will contribute to solving complex analytical challenges related to proteins and biologics while ensuring that all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements.Working closely with colleagues across Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions, you will play an important role in advancing development projects from early-stage investigations through method validation and implementation.This role offers a broad range of scientific and technical challenges, providing opportunities to deepen your expertise while contributing to projects with real impact on Galderma's future portfolio. Key responsibilities· Develop, optimize, and validate analytical methods for proteins and related biological materials.· Plan, execute, analyze, and document experimental work.· Interpret analytical data and provide scientifically sound conclusions and recommendations.· Author protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.· Provide analytical expertise and support within cross-functional development projects.· Ensure that all activities are performed in accordance with GMP, internal procedures, and relevant regulatory requirements.· Support project teams by identifying scientific solutions to analytical challenges.· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory and analytical development processes. Your profile You are a curious and collaborative scientist who enjoys combining scientific expertise with practical problem-solving. You are motivated by understanding complex biological systems and translating analytical results into meaningful insights that support product development.You thrive in an environment where teamwork, scientific discussion, and continuous learning are valued. At the same time, you take ownership of your work, approach challenges with a structured mindset, and maintain a strong focus on quality and scientific integrity.You are comfortable working in project-based environments, communicating complex information clearly, and collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds. What you'll bringTo be successful in this role, you bring:· A university degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biology, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.· Experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or broader life sciences industry.· Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, biochemistry, protein characterization, or related scientific fields.· Experience with analytical method development and validation.· Experience working in regulated environments and familiarity with GMP and associated quality requirements.· Experience interpreting regulatory guidelines, pharmacopeias, and scientific standards.· Fluency in both English and Swedish, written and spoken. Preferred qualifications Experience in any of the following areas would be considered an advantage:    Immunology and anti-drug antibody (ADA) testing.    Protein therapeutics, biologics, or biosimilar development.    Advanced protein characterization techniques.    Analytical support in cross-functional development projects.    Statistical evaluation of analytical data. Location and otherThis position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Please note that Galderma may conduct pre-employment background and security checks for certain positions. These checks are performed by an external provider and only with the candidate's consent. Why GaldermaAt Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

title: Sjuksköterska till avdelning 96 LAH
description: Som sjuksköterska hos oss får du ett varierat arbete inom både öppen-, sluten och hemsjukvård, tillsammans med kollegor med bred kompetens. Här finns möjlighet att utvecklas, lära av andra och bidra med din egen erfarenhet, oavsett om du är nyutexaminerad eller erfaren.Vårt erbjudandeFör livet framåt. Region Östergötland har höga ambitioner och ett ansvarsfullt uppdrag. Det handlar om hälsa och vård, om vår regions utveckling och om dem som lever och vistas här. Vi vill fortsätta att vara i framkant, med vård, forskning och utbildning. Det innebär att våga tänka nytt – och att ha de bästa medarbetarna. Därför erbjuder vi unika möjligheter till vidare lärande och satsar på moderna miljöer med effektiva system och verktyg. Många av oss möter patienter och närstående, andra skapar förutsättningarna för livsviktiga insatser. Hos oss jobbar fantastiska människor mot samma mål – att göra skillnad på riktigt, och för livet framåt.I sektion LAH på Närvårdskliniken får du möjlighet att arbeta i unika miljöer och i multiprofessionella välfungerande team. Våra team består av läkare, sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, arbetsterapeut, fysioterapeut och kurator.Du kommer träffa våra patienter på vår avdelning men en stor del av vår verksamhet sker också utanför sjukhuset i patienternas hem. Ibland besöker vi patienterna för en gemensam bedömning i olika teamkonstellationer, ibland träffar du patienten själv och diskuterar med ditt team innan och/eller efter besöket. Läs gärna vår karriärstege för sjuksköterskor och om dina förmåner hos oss, här hittar du även information om bestämmelser gällande lön och ersättningar.ArbetsbeskrivningVi söker sjuksköterska för ett omväxlande arbete inom klinikens olika enheter. Du kan vara erfaren eller nyutexaminerad, personliga egenskaper är avgörande. Hos oss får du arbeta självständigt i team tillsammans med andra sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, läkare, arbetsterapeut, fysioterapeut och kurator. Här finns en samlad kompetens och medarbetare som delar med sig till varandra av sina kliniska och teoretiska kunskaper. Vi bedriver en dygnet runt-verksamhet och alla hjälps åt att leverera den vård våra medborgare är i behov av. Vårt arbete underlättas av bärbart arbetssätt där patientjournal alltid finns tillgänglig.Vi baserar vårt arbete efter principen om helhetsvård, som bygger på ömsesidig respekt och förståelse för patientens självkänsla och vilja. Alla symtom behöver lindras oavsett om de är fysiska, psykiska, andliga eller emotionella. Det handlar om insatser för att öka livskvalitet och välbefinnande. Fokus ligger på att skapa en professionell relation med patienten och dennes närstående.Klinikens medarbetare är en arbetsgrupp i olika åldrar, med olika bakgrund och med olika yrkeserfarenheter och kompetenser. I arbetslaget finns kollegor med spetskompetens inom palliativ vård, onkologi, akutsjukvård, öppen hälso-och sjukvård, geriatrik och gynekologi. Så välkommen med din kompetens!ArbetsgruppDu blir stationerad i ett av våra två vårdlag eller avdelning 96 och har din fasta punkt där men i den dagliga verksamheten hjälps vi åt och fördelar våra personella resurser där de bäst behövs utifrån kunskap och kompetens. Vi strävar efter att öka kompetensen hos våra medarbetare och du kommer att få rotera mellan öppen- och slutenvård och över dygnets alla timmar.Om digVi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska och har B-körkort. title: Post-doc position at the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness at SSE
description: About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research areaWellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.The roleThe postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events. Your profileThe applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and to be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm. Qualifications    PhD in business administration, psychology or a related field. Candidates with a set dissertation date may also apply.    A strong publication record in wellbeing science, including first-authored articles in leading international peer-reviewed journals    Documented expertise in language-based assessment of psychological constructs    Methodological and quantitative competence and programming in R and/or Python    Demonstrated research independence and an established international research network    Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular scienceMeritorious    Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text    Development of open research software or openly shared models    Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics How to apply: Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest December 15, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:     A curriculum vitae     A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).     Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)     Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts     Names and contact information for two people willing to provide references. We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before December 15, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around April 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of two years.For further questions on the positions, please contact Assistant professor and Executive Director Fredrik Lange at fredrik.lange@hhs.seAbout the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.
