title: Scientist
description: Are you passionate about protein analytics and scientific problem-solving? Would you like to contribute to the development of innovative injectable products in a global, science-driven organization? We are looking for a Scientist to join our Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry team within Injectables Development in Uppsala.In this role, you will contribute to the development and validation of analytical methods that support the advancement of new products and technologies. Working in a collaborative and highly skilled environment, you will help generate the scientific insights that drive innovation and ensure product quality throughout development.This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing organization where your expertise will contribute directly to the future of injectable aesthetics.Make your mark. Grow with us.  Your team Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry is part of Galderma's Injectables Development organization in Uppsala. The team provides analytical expertise that supports the development of innovative products and technologies, helping to strengthen and expand Galderma's portfolio.You will join a collaborative and highly engaged team where knowledge sharing, scientific curiosity, and mutual support are valued. Together, we work in a dynamic environment where quality, innovation, and patient focus guide everything we do. Your missionAs a Scientist within Analytical Development – Protein Chemistry, you will plan, perform, and interpret analytical studies supporting product and process development. You will contribute to solving complex analytical challenges related to proteins and biologics while ensuring that all activities are conducted in accordance with applicable quality standards and regulatory requirements.Working closely with colleagues across Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other functions, you will play an important role in advancing development projects from early-stage investigations through method validation and implementation.This role offers a broad range of scientific and technical challenges, providing opportunities to deepen your expertise while contributing to projects with real impact on Galderma's future portfolio. Key responsibilities· Develop, optimize, and validate analytical methods for proteins and related biological materials.· Plan, execute, analyze, and document experimental work.· Interpret analytical data and provide scientifically sound conclusions and recommendations.· Author protocols, reports, SOPs, and other technical documentation.· Provide analytical expertise and support within cross-functional development projects.· Ensure that all activities are performed in accordance with GMP, internal procedures, and relevant regulatory requirements.· Support project teams by identifying scientific solutions to analytical challenges.· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory and analytical development processes. Your profile You are a curious and collaborative scientist who enjoys combining scientific expertise with practical problem-solving. You are motivated by understanding complex biological systems and translating analytical results into meaningful insights that support product development.You thrive in an environment where teamwork, scientific discussion, and continuous learning are valued. At the same time, you take ownership of your work, approach challenges with a structured mindset, and maintain a strong focus on quality and scientific integrity.You are comfortable working in project-based environments, communicating complex information clearly, and collaborating with colleagues from different disciplines and backgrounds. What you'll bringTo be successful in this role, you bring:· A university degree in Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, Biology, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.· Experience working within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or broader life sciences industry.· Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry, biochemistry, protein characterization, or related scientific fields.· Experience with analytical method development and validation.· Experience working in regulated environments and familiarity with GMP and associated quality requirements.· Experience interpreting regulatory guidelines, pharmacopeias, and scientific standards.· Fluency in both English and Swedish, written and spoken. title: Admissions coordinator to the Stockholm School of Economics
description: The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.We offer youA diverse role at one of the top business schools in Europe with ambitious students and staff in a dynamic, academic environment. This role is ideal for a highly organized, people-oriented person who enjoys complex processes.The roleWe are looking for Admissions coordinator for our BSc programs. The successful candidate will belong to a team of Admissions & Program management at Education Office, reporting to Group Manager of that team.Your tasks include, but are not limited to:    Coordinating application and admissions process for the BSc programs, ensuring an efficient, accurate and applicant-focused process.    Assessing applications, including eligibility, qualifications and supporting documentation, and participating actively in the selection of candidates.    Guiding prospective students and applicants regarding SSE, the BSc programs, admissions requirements and the application process.    Collaborating with faculty, and other internal and external stakeholders involved in admissions.    Contributing to recruitment and conversion activities for prospective and admitted students, including information sessions, events and other applicant-facing activities.    Supporting the Program Manager for the BSc in Business & Economics with diverse program-related tasks and activities, in accordance with the agreed division of responsibilities and based on the needs of the program.    Contributing to the continuous development of admissions processes, systems and ways of working, including the use of digital tools and AI where relevant.    Working in a dynamic organization where priorities, processes and responsibilities may evolve. You should therefore be comfortable adapting to change, taking on new tasks and contributing to developing new ways of working.    Occasional travel and participation in events outside regular office activities may occur.Your profileAs Admissions Coordinator, you will be coordinating admissions process and processing applications and enquiries, often within fixed deadlines. You therefore need to be structured, detail-oriented and comfortable taking responsibility for processes from start to finish. You are proactive, flexible and able to prioritize while maintaining a high level of accuracy and service.At the same time, admissions process is highly collaborative, and you enjoy working closely with colleagues, faculty and other stakeholders. The position involves contact with prospective students and applicants. You therefore have strong interpersonal and communication skills and can explain sometimes complex admissions requirements in a clear, professional and service-minded way. You are also comfortable handling challenging cases and communicating decisions consistently and respectfully. You are comfortable interpreting admissions requirements, assessing applicants and documentation against established criteria, and applying rules and procedures consistently.Qualifications:    An academic education    Experience of, or a strong understanding of, admissions processes within Swedish higher education.    Experience of working with Swedish and international high school qualifications    Swedish and English, both spoken and written.    An interest in how generative AI and digital tools can support efficient and high-quality admissions processes.Meritorious:    Previous experience working with admissions in Swedish higher education, particularly BSc admissions.    International experience or previous experience working in an international environment is an asset.    Good knowledge of Swedish higher-education admissions processes, eligibility requirements, merit rating and selection principles.    Experience assessing Swedish and international upper-secondary qualifications and supporting documentation.    Previous experience working in NyA and/or Ladok, or other systems used in higher-education admissions.    Previous experience working with CRM or application-management systems.OtherThis is a permanent position of 100% with an initial probationary period of six months. Start preferably in January or according to agreement. We encourage you to apply promptly as we are actively reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.Please be aware that we conduct background checks on final candidates for this position.About the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description: Join the Revolution in Commercial Vehicle Tech at Coretura!Our AI Lab builds the shared platform that teams across Coretura use to develop and run AI products safely and reliably. We're looking for a senior software engineer to help design, build and run it.What you’ll doYou will work with the AI Lab to set the platform's technical direction, and take on a large share of the hands-on work yourself. Together, you'll build the platform that gives teams access to AI models across providers, manages and retrieves the data their AI products rely on, and provides the harnesses agents are built and run in. You'll also build agents yourself, and the observability that shows whether an AI product is giving the right answers, not just whether it's running.Beyond that, your work will include:    Security and safety by level: controls and evaluations that scale with how autonomous an AI system is and how safety-critical its use is, from everyday AI tools to autonomous agents, with prompt injection defences built in. The higher the level, the more a system has to prove before release and the more closely it's monitored once live. You'll build this together with our Security Hub.    Cost and resilience: usage metering built into the platform so teams can see what their AI products consume, and recovery tested for each AI product as a whole (model, knowledge base, prompts and tool integrations), not just the servers it runs on.    AI assets as code: prompts, agent definitions, model versions and evaluation datasets, versioned and released through automated pipelines. They change often and any change can shift how a product behaves, so every change is automatically tested, evaluated and traceable before it ships.Build to discover, then share what you learn. When we need to know whether an approach works, you build a working version, then use it to help colleagues across Coretura understand what works, what doesn't and why. As a senior engineer, you'll combine those findings with your own experience to help set where the platform goes next. You'll use AI coding agents in your own daily work and help other engineers adopt them safely. You'll also review designs and code, mentor the engineers around you, and hand over ownership of components as they're ready for it.You'll report to the AI Lab Lead and work closely with our Digital Architect and the teams behind our developer and data platforms.What you bringA solid background in software engineering, but we care far more about what you've done than how long you've been doing it. You've owned a production system end to end, including its roadmap, incidents and costs, and you've handed parts of it over to other engineers along the way.You're comfortable with:    Using AI coding agents as a normal part of how you write code, with work you can show for it    Building AI applications that people can rely on: agents, retrieval (RAG), model APIs and gateways, along with the evaluations that show they behave as intended    Defining cloud infrastructure in code and shipping through CI/CD as part of how you build software, with the observability to see how it behaves once it's running    Practical security, from least privilege and secrets management to prompt injection defences    Writing well-tested, maintainable code in whatever language the problem calls for, and picking up a new one when you need toYou look for more efficient ways to build and run things, bring structure to an unclear situation without locking it down too early, and can explain a trade-off so that engineers, security and leadership all understand it. Fluent English is a must.Why Coretura?We're a joint venture between Volvo Group and Daimler Truck, building a shared software platform for the next generation of commercial vehicles. We're a young company with very little legacy to work around, backed by two of the world's largest commercial vehicle manufacturers.The AI platform serves teams across the company, so your work will directly affect how they build and ship software.If this sounds like the work you want to do, we look forward to your application.Next steps Ready to build the future of commercial vehicles?We review applications on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to submit yours!Last application date: 4th of December 2026.Questions? Don’t hesitate to reach out to Frida Greve, frida.greve@coretura.com if you have any questions regarding the position.Please note we do not accept any applications via email.About our recruitment process  We are committed to a safe and secure working environment. As a mandatory part of our recruitment process, we carry out drug and alcohol testing and background checks via 2Secure on the final candidate. The background check covers personal details, financial information, company engagements, legal matters, CV verification, media and internet presence, as well as a risk analysis and recommendation.A negative drug and alcohol test and an approved background check are required before a formal offer can be made. All checks are carried out in accordance with GDPR, and candidates are always informed in advance.Read more →

title: MEP Manager
description: Key Requirements:    A third level qualification in a related field    5 years post qualification experience in a similar roleAs a member of the project management team, you have the opportunity to influence safety culture onsite by demonstrating personal commitment, setting clear expectations, and effectively communicating safety policies. By consistently modelling safe behaviour, prioritizing safety above productivity, and ensuring that all workers receive proper training and resources, you can foster an environment where safety is ingrained in every aspect of the construction process. Encouraging open communication, recognizing and rewarding safe behaviour, and conducting regular inspections further reinforce the importance of safety. By taking these steps, you can help create a culture where safety is a shared value and a top priority for all stakeholders involved in the project.Key Responsibilities:The Primary objective of the role is to provide MEPF support to Clients CM team, the GC team and the MEPF subcontractors on the client’s data centre builds. This involves interfacing with the GC/Client & MEPF Contractors / Clients CM / Clients DE / Clients Security / Client & MEP Consultants / Clients Cx / Local authorities and others as needed.Reporting to the MEP Operations Director your key responsibilities for the role will include but will not be limited to the following:    Foster a team approach to delivering your projects with your team.    Encourage your team to grow in their own roles and provide professional development where appropriate.    Review of IFC design for design issues / improvements and to determine where local alternatives with better lead times could be applied    Review incoming design change directives for impact to MEP works and establish if they can be implemented depending on site progress, and if they can be implemented determine a reasonable schedule impact    Work with the MEPF contractors and offer technical support on MEPF systems, clarify clients’ expectations and typical installation practices for client which may not necessarily be clarified on the IFC design    Review alternative technical proposals from the MEPF contractors to determine if proposal would be acceptable to client prior to formal submission where the contractor is required / chooses to deviate from the specification / design    Track and monitor MEPF shop drawings, RFI’s and technical submittals and push same tracking equipment delivery dates for both MEPF contractors and OFCI Vendors to maintain project schedule.    Provide the OFCI Vendors with an insight into MEPF programme in order to align the Clients works affecting the efficient MEPF progress.    Coordinate the sequence of MEPF works on behalf of the GC    Track, monitor and report on MEPF progress daily whilst monitoring manpower and equipment deployed across the sites    Review of progress against resources and forecast required resources to be deployed in order to meet / recover schedule    Offering MEPF contractors’ advice on long lead equipment handling, installation, and commissioning    Ensuring MEPF contractor provided equipment for installations and testing is secured well in advance    Review the quality of the MEPF installation whilst it is work in progress to minimize reworks    Advise MEPF contractors of client’s best practices and standards. Communicate clients’ expectations to the MEPF teams    Work with the MEPF contractors to close out comments and nonconformance reports    Review the MEPF contractors ITP’s, Inspection notices, pre-commissioning and commissioning plans and procedures with the aid of the commissioning manager    Provide guidance to the MEPF contractors on installation and coordination at site    Review and determine acceptable deviations from the design / shop drawings    Coordinate with the LLE vendors for equipment delivery, installation, testing and commissioning.    Review reported VS actual progress at site to verify contractor is on or behind schedule    Provide MEPF contractors with guidance on commissioning and oversee MEPF L1-L3 commissioning    Interface and support clients Cx team for L4-L5 commissioning    Management of MEPF contractors through to handover (TOC).    Review MEPF variations or change to scope and liaise with the commercial team for approval.    Identify potential risks and challenges related to MEP systems and develop mitigation strategies.    Implement and enforce quality control standards for MEP installations.    Develop and manage the project schedule for MEP installations, coordinating with other construction activities.    Facilitate effective communication between different project teams, subcontractors, and clients.    Facilitate the handover of MEP systems to the building owner or operator.    Lead by example and demonstrate a commitment to safety, quality, and professionalism.    Clearly define roles and responsibilities for each MEP team member on the project.    Prioritize safety and enforce strict adherence to safety protocols.    Regularly walk the construction site to observe work progress and ensure tasks are being performed according to specifications.    Document changes to the project plan, as well as any issues that may impact the schedule or budget.Strong time management and communication skills are essential to this role as well as computer literacy and the ability to prepare reports and administer necessary paperwork.

title: Post-doc position at the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness at SSE
description: About the Center for wellbeing, welfare and happiness and research areaWellbeing research examines how people experience and evaluate their lives, what enables them to thrive, and how individuals, organizations and societies can contribute to better lives. The field brings together perspectives from psychology, economics and behavioural science to understand different dimensions of wellbeing, including happiness, meaning in life and psychological richness. At the Center for Wellbeing, Welfare and Happiness (CWWH), we connect these questions to the development of knowledge that can inform policy and practice.A central methodological challenge is how to capture the richness of people’s experiences through reliable and valid measures. Advances in natural language processing and large language models offer opportunities to complement traditional rating scales with systematic analyses of people’s own descriptions of their lives, emotions and experiences. This research combines wellbeing science, psychometrics and computational methods to investigate what language-based assessments can reveal about wellbeing, how they relate to established measures, and how they can capture differences between people and changes over time. The position will contribute to developing and validating these approaches, with relevance to the center’s research in Sweden and across countries.The roleThe postdoc will develop an independent research line on the measurement of wellbeing beyond traditional rating scales, with a focus on natural language (open-ended responses, text and speech) analyzed with computational methods, including large language models.The postdoc will contribute to the center's work on wellbeing in Sweden and across nations, co-author with center researchers, and connect CWWH to international collaborators and funding opportunities. The role also includes active participation in the center's outreach, such as media, public lectures and events. Your profileThe applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and to be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm. Qualifications    PhD in business administration, psychology or a related field. Candidates with a set dissertation date may also apply.    A strong publication record in wellbeing science, including first-authored articles in leading international peer-reviewed journals    Documented expertise in language-based assessment of psychological constructs    Methodological and quantitative competence and programming in R and/or Python    Demonstrated research independence and an established international research network    Documented experience communicating research to non-academic audiences, e.g., media, public lectures or popular scienceMeritorious    Experience with assessment methods beyond self-report, e.g., implicit measures or automated coding of text    Development of open research software or openly shared models    Applied collaborations with organizations or industry, e.g., in work-related wellbeing or psychometrics How to apply: Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest December 15, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:     A curriculum vitae     A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).     Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)     Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts     Names and contact information for two people willing to provide references. We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before December 15, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around April 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of two years.For further questions on the positions, please contact Assistant professor and Executive Director Fredrik Lange at fredrik.lange@hhs.seAbout the Stockholm School of EconomicsThe Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Flödesledare - Power Pack, Surface Division
description: Company description:Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countriesJob description:Vill du leda människor, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa förutsättningar för en välfungerande produktion? Vi söker dig som motiveras av att skapa engagemang, utveckla människor och få team att lyckas tillsammans.  Allt börjar med människor. Människor som du. Bli en del av vårt team Vill du vara med och bygga upp något helt nytt från grunden? Vi tar nu hem monteringen av Power Pack och etablerar i samband med detta en helt ny avdelning med taktade produktionslinor. Därför söker vi en flödesledare som vill ta en nyckelroll i uppbyggnaden av den nya verksamheten. I rollen får du möjlighet att forma teamet, driva bemanningen och utveckla arbetssätt och produktionsflöden för att skapa en stabil och effektiv verksamhet från start. Du blir samtidigt en del av vår operativa ledningsgrupp tillsammans med tio andra flödesledare. Här får du ett nära samarbete med erfarna kollegor och en viktig roll i att tillsammans skapa en säker, stabil och välfungerande produktion.  Ditt uppdrag Som flödesledare leder du den operativa verksamheten och har personalansvar för cirka 20-25 medarbetare på skiftet. Du arbetar tvärfunktionellt och har som uppdrag att leverera moduler i rätt tid och med rätt bemanning. Tillsammans med teamet säkerställer du att vi levererar produkter med hög kvalitet, i rätt tid och på ett säkert sätt. Rollen kombinerar operativt ledarskap med administrativa uppgifter och du tillbringar en stor del av din arbetstid ute i verksamheten. Du kommer bland annat att:     Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetarna.      Ansvara för medarbetarsamtal, kompetensutveckling och andra personalrelaterade processer.      Säkerställa att rätt kompetens och resurser finns på plats utifrån verksamhetens behov.      Hålla dagliga avstämningar och följa upp teamets mål och resultat.        Bidra till arbetsmiljö- och förbättringsarbetet, exempelvis genom att hålla skyddsronder samt uppföljningar kopplade till 5S.      Säkerställa en smidig överlämning mellan dag- och eftermiddagsskiftet.  Din profil  Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta nära verksamheten och motiveras av att skapa förutsättningar för andra att lyckas. Du kommunicerar tydligt, bygger förtroende genom närvaro och lyhördhet och skapar engagemang kring gemensamma mål. Du samarbetar väl med andra, bygger goda relationer och bidrar till en miljö där människor känner sig inkluderade, delaktiga och uppmuntras att utvecklas. Du känner dig trygg i att ta ansvar, göra prioriteringar och prova nya arbetssätt som bidrar till teamets och verksamhetens utveckling. Vi välkomnar olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder och värdesätter din vilja att leda, utveckla människor och bidra till verksamhetens framgång. Vi söker dig som      Har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom produktion.      Har ett intresse för att leda och utveckla människor.      Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.      Har god datorvana.      Erfarenhet från en ledande, samordnande eller coachande roll.      Erfarenhet av projektledning.      Erfarenhet av förbättrings- och förändringsarbete.  Placering och övrig information Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning placerad inom Surface Division, vid produktionsanläggningen i Norra bro, Örebro.  Arbetstiden är förlagd dagtid, kl. 07:30 – 16:15. Ledarskapsförväntningar På Epiroc förväntar vi oss att våra ledare ska vara inspiratörer, acceleratorer och nytänkare. Vi värdesätter ledare som leder genom att vara förebilder och som har modet att utmana status quo. Säkerhet och hållbarhet är våra högsta prioriteringar, och vi förväntar oss att våra ledare tar en aktiv roll i att främja säkerhet, inkludering och mångfald. Utöver detta värnar våra ledare om våra anställdas välbefinnande och kontinuerliga utveckling. Vi söker dig som vågar tro på nya idéer och ser möjligheter där andra ser utmaningar.  Ansökan och kontaktinformation  Vi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 27/11- 2026. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter. För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta: Rekryterande chef Andreas Persson, andreas.f.persson@epiroc.com Rekryteringsspecialist, Susanne Kjellman, susanne.kjellman@external.epiroc.com

title: Spaceport Engineer  EGSE
description: Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.   With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.   Are you fueled by a passion for people and the ambition to create an awesome workplace?  Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?    If you answer yes to these questions, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as EGSE (Electrical ground support equipment) Spaceport Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.   Help build the systems that make rocket launches possible! As a Spaceport Engineer – EGSE, you will design, build and maintain the electrical ground support equipment used in testing and launch operations. Combining hands-on work with system ownership, you will collaborate with operations teams, suppliers and customers to bring reliable data acquisition and control systems into use. JOB REQUIREMENTS     A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.     A sound understanding of electrical engineering principles, particularly low-voltage instrumentation and control circuits.     Experience programming or configuring PLC and HMI systems, and using electrical drawings to build or troubleshoot panels and wiring harnesses.     A practical approach to solving technical problems, with the ability to take initiative and work closely with others to keep projects moving. Desired We welcome different technical backgrounds. Experience in some of the following areas would be valuable, and you do not need to bring them all:     Data acquisition and control systems in aerospace, industrial facilities or similar environments.     Technical documentation such as P&IDs, wiring schematics, control descriptions and instrument lists.     Industrial networks, communication protocols and hardware interfaces, or National Instruments tools used with LabVIEW.     Safety requirements and hazard analysis for ground support equipment.     Supporting technicians or mentoring junior engineers. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES    Design and develop instrumentation, data acquisition, PLC and HMI systems, including the electrical drawings and documentation needed to build and maintain them.     Build, test, troubleshoot and commission equipment, including instrument calibration and configuration.     Coordinate installation from site surveys and supplier quotations through to commissioning, training and technical support.     Work with operations teams to deliver safe, reliable systems that meet project, regulatory and operational requirements.     Carry out system checkouts and support testing and launch campaigns, including launch-day operations.     Define requirements and coordinate the installation of supporting power and communications infrastructure.  JOB BENEFITSWe offer you       A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.      An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.      An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.   Additional benefits  In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.       Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.      Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.       Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.      Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.      Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  LOCATIONThis is a full-time, permanent position based at our Space Center Esrange outside of Kiruna.  NEXT STEPIf this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.  When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.   As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.   WE HEALP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACESSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.  With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.    We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Supply Chain Sales Support Manager
description: Do you enjoy creating clarity at the intersection of customers, Sales and Supply Chain? We’re looking for a Supply Chain Sales Support Manager to lead our global function and develop a proactive, structured and data-driven service that colleagues and customers can rely on. At Seco, collaboration, responsibility, curiosity and continuous improvement guide how we work and grow. Here, you get to:     Lead a global function at the heart of customer order flow.     Shape how Sales and Supply Chain work together through clear governance, service levels, KPIs and digital tools.     Join a collaborative environment where curiosity and continuous learning are valued.   About the job  You lead and develop the global Supply Chain Sales Support function, creating a standardized, customer-focused and efficient interface between Sales and our end-to-end supply chain. With a clear focus on governance and proactive support, you ensure that customer needs, order exceptions and supply constraints are translated into priorities and coordinated action. The function is in the middle of a shift: building on a strong foundation in case handling towards an end-to-end control and improvement capability. You lead that change, and you lead it through people. Developing your team’s skills, ownership and confidence is as much a part of the job as the processes and tools. Job responsibilities     Lead, coach and develop the Supply Chain Sales Support team: set clear roles and expectations, build capability in customer communication, supply chain understanding, problem-solving and case management, and grow people into broader ownership.     Lead the development towards proactive exception management, building on the team’s case-handling expertise, and make new ways of working stick in daily operations.     Establish and maintain global governance across the order-to-delivery flow, including ownership boundaries, decision rights and escalation paths.     Act as the primary supply chain interface for Sales and Customer Service regarding prioritized orders, supply exceptions and special customer requirements.     Develop the service model, including case categories, service levels, prioritization principles, escalation protocols and KPIs.     Use case data and performance insights to identify root causes and drive structural improvements with the responsible process owners.     Drive digitalization of case management, workflows, reporting and knowledge management, reducing repetitive demand through automation and self-service. Location and flexibility  The position is flexible is preferably based in Fagersta, Sweden, but another Seco location can be considered for the right candidate. We offer a hybrid working model that combines time at the office with remote work. Your profile   You have solid experience in supply chain, logistics, planning, order management or customer service operations. Having worked at the intersection of a commercial organization and operational supply chain functions, you’re comfortable creating structure across complex, cross-functional environments and using data to support decisions. You communicate fluently in English; Swedish is considered an advantage. Your background includes:      Experience establishing processes, ownership models, escalation paths or service frameworks across multiple functions.     Knowledge of customer-order exceptions, escalations and prioritization, preferably within a case-based way of working.     The ability to identify recurring operational issues, uncover root causes and turn insights into structural improvements.     Experience using CRM or case-management systems, ERP data, KPIs and reporting.     People leadership experience and a university degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering or equivalent experience. Customer focus and structure are central to your way of working. You simplify complex supply chain situations, create a shared understanding among commercial and operational colleagues and distinguish individual exceptions from structural problems. Calm and solution-focused, you challenge unnecessary manual work and fragmented processes while moving issues confidently towards resolution. The teamYou lead the global Supply Chain Sales Support team and work closely with Sales, Customer Service, Planning, Logistics, Production Units, Distribution Centres, IT and other operational functions. Together, you create globally consistent ways of working while accommodating relevant local requirements. Our Seco culture   At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. description: Aimpoint AB is the company that invented and developed the red dot sight, for which we are today the world-leading provider. Working with robots, vision systems, PLC-controlled equipment, and advanced manufacturing technologies, you will play a vital role in supporting Aimpoint's continued growth and operational excellence.As our production capacity expands, you will also participate in the installation, commissioning, and optimization of new automated production lines and equipment.This position is equipment.    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance to maximize equipment uptime and reliability.    Analyze recurring issues, identify root causes, and implement long-term improvements.    Support production with expertise in automation, robotics, electrical systems, and machine troubleshooting.    Participate in the installation, commissioning, and optimization of new production lines and equipment.    Document maintenance activities and improvement actions in the maintenance management system (Idus).    Repair, adjust, and optimize tools and production equipment.    Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across production and maintenance.    Support training and knowledge sharing related to new equipment, processes, and working methods.Required Qualifications    Technical education within Automation, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Technology, Maintenance, or equivalent experience.    Experience working with automated production equipment in a manufacturing environment.    Strong hands-on experience in troubleshooting electrical, mechanical and automated production equipment.    Familiarity with maintenance systems and technical documentation.    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.It is considered a strong advantage if you also have experience with:    ABB robots and robotic production equipment.    Cognex vision systems and machine vision technology.    Siemens PLCs and TIA Portal.    Pneumatic systems and industrial automation components.    Reading and troubleshooting electrical schematics.    LEAN manufacturing, TPM, and continuous improvement initiatives.    Root cause analysis and systematic problem-solving methodologies.To succeed in this role, you are analytical, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of technical challenges independently. You enjoy working hands-on in a production environment and thrive when solving problems that have a direct impact on production performance.You see problems as challenges and work proactively to prevent production disruptions.You will join a skilled Production Support team working closely with Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering and Production Operations.The salary range for this position is SEK 38 000–45 000 depending on experience and qualifications.Why Aimpoint?We are driven by our core values: Performance, Innovation, and Commitment! - and we believe you are too!Just like us, you enjoy having fun at work and find interaction with others both challenging and rewarding. title: Development Team Lead- Team Notification & Communication
description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. Every booking confirmation, schedule-change alert, receipt, and proactive notification a customer receives runs through your team’s systems — and so does the account functionality we’re actively building out to give travelers more control and visibility over their own data.You won’t just lead a team; you will be the bridge between Product, Platform, and the many domain teams who depend on reliable, well-governed communication and account infrastructure. Collaborate with your manager to make sure the team follows their agreed upon ways of working. You will lead a group of experienced engineers in maintaining a high-trust, high-reliability platform while helping shape where it goes next.Your ResponsibilitiesCoordinate Efforts: Keep the team aligned across two active fronts — communication infrastructure and the evolving Customer Account as well as future initiatives — ensuring both move forward smoothly without one starving the other of attention.Facilitate Communication: Serve as the bridge between your engineers and the stakeholders who depend on your systems, from Product Owners to stakeholders to the many domain teams whose customer-facing flows rely on your infrastructure.Technical Guidance: Drive the technical quality bar across both domains. Coordinate direction on complex technical issues with the help of the team.Team Empowerment: Empower your engineers to do their best work without micromanaging. Foster a culture of ownership for the health and performance of everything the team builds.Stakeholder Management: Keep everyone informed from your engineers to management, and communicate expectations as priorities shift.Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for the team’s output — staying hands-on enough to guide technical decisions credibly, participating in recruitment, and providing appraisal input to your manager.Requirements    6+ years of experience in Java development, with exposure to system design and architecture.    Proven leadership or mentorship experience in a technical role.    A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build bridges between technical and business teams.BenefitsAt the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:    Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.    We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location    We love gaming and after work activities.    We know the value of personal development and continuous training.    Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

title: Mécanicien⸱ne / Technicien⸱ne Cycle et sports  - CDI 80-100% - BIENNE
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Mécanicien?ne / Technicien?ne Cycle et sports (H/F) - CDI 80-100% - BIENNE---Moving People Through The Wonders Of Sport------------------------------------------ Mécanicien?ne / Technicien?ne Cycle et sports (H/F) \- CDI 80\-100% \- BIENNE============================================================================== **Ton futur terrain de jeu**Tu rejoindras le magasin de **Bienne**, d'une surface de 2600m2, constitué d’une équipe de **28 collaborateurs.** Ton périmètre **Atelier \- Cycle \- Location** est au cœur de notre stratégie locale. L'équipe est composée de 10 passionnés dont 2 techniciens. **Rejoins une aventure qui n'en finit pas de grandir**Decathlon en Suisse, c'est une success story qui a débuté en 2017 à Neuchâtel. Depuis, nous avons ouvert une dizaine de magasins par an pour atteindre aujourd'hui 50 points de vente. Et on ne compte pas s'arrêter là ! Notre expansion se poursuit, notamment en Suisse alémanique, offrant des opportunités de carrière partout dans le pays. **Et maintenant, place au métier :**Tu cherches un métier où tu n'es pas juste là pour serrer des boulons derrière un établi ? Tu as envie de prendre des décisions et d'être au contact direct des sportifs ? Tu rêves d’allier ton expertise technique à un vrai sens du service client ?Alors ce poste est fait pour toi. **Pourquoi ?**1.  **Ton atelier est ta propre entreprise.** Chez Decathlon, nous aimons donner des responsabilités à nos coéquipiers. Tu ne fais pas qu'exécuter des réparations : tu dois anticiper les périodes de forte activité, gérer et garantir la justesse de ton stock de pièces détachées, et suivre tes indicateurs de performance (croissance, taux de réparation, satisfaction client).2.  **Tu es le trait d'union entre la technique et l'humain.** Le client est au centre de tout. Que ce soit pour fournir un diagnostic précis, proposer le bon choix de services (seconde vie, entretien) ou simplement rassurer un sportif sur son matériel, tu es sur le terrain. Ton expertise technique ne vaut que si elle est partagée avec le sourire.3.  **Tu donnes de la confiance et tu en reçois.** Tu as une idée pour améliorer l'efficience de l'atelier ou réduire nos délais de traitement ? Tu as le droit d'essayer, de te tromper, et d'apprendre. C'est en prenant des initiatives que l'on grandit. De plus, ce poste est un excellent tremplin : si tu as de l'ambition, de nombreuses opportunités d'évolution t'attendent (Référent Atelier, Technicien Régional...). **Ce poste N'EST PAS fait pour toi si...*** Tu ne veux réparer QUE des vélos (chez nous, un atelier touche à tout : skis, fitness, flocage/personnalisation, etc. Même si les vélos concernent la grande majorité de nos réparations)* Tu n'es intéressé?e QUE par la technique pure et le contact CLIENT t'ennuie* Tu aimes les structures "top\-down" et tu attends qu'on prenne les décisions à ta place* Tu n'es pas prêt?e à travailler les samedis (car c’est le moment où nos clients ont le plus besoin de nous) **Un?e Technicien?ne atelier, ça fait quoi ?**Ta mission est double : assurer la qualité irréprochable de tes prestations techniques tout en garantissant une expérience client exceptionnelle.Au quotidien, tes responsabilités se divisent en deux grands axes : **1\. Le diagnostic et la relation client :*** Accueillir le client, écouter son besoin et fournir un diagnostic fiable et précis* Appliquer les standards de la prise en charge atelier et suivre les procédures de diagnostic* Vendre nos produits et services (physiquement et digitalement) et proposer systématiquement le bon choix de services d'économie circulaire* Proposer un devis et un délai adaptés aux besoins du sportif* Gérer l'encaissement et la remise du matériel avec des conseils d'entretien* Tes indicateurs de réussite (KPIs) : % de correct diagnostic, % de part de PEC (“prise en charge”) locale, Croissance du nombre d’interventions (PEC), Panier moyen payant. **2\. Les prestations techniques et opérationnelles :*** Réaliser les prestations de réparation, d'entretien et de remise en état selon les standards de sécurité Decathlon.* Assurer la personnalisation des produits (flocage, gravure...).* Garantir l'exactitude de ton stock de pièces détachées et commander ce qu'il manque.* Veiller à maintenir un environnement de travail sûr, propre et sécurisé.* Tes indicateurs de réussite (KPIs) : Taux de réparation, Délai de traitement local, Fiabilité du stock, Efficience atelier, Croissance de la GMV sur la personnalisation et récompenses, NPS personnalisation. **Ce que nous attendons de toi :*** Tu possèdes une **formation technique (type CFC, AFP**) et une expérience prouvée en mécanique (cycle idéalement, ski/fitness un gros plus)* Tu es un?e véritable **passionné?e de sport** et tu es pratiquant?e*  **Tu es orienté?e solutions** : face à un problème mécanique ou un client insatisfait, tu trouves toujours le moyen d'arranger les choses.*  **Tu es organisé?e**, rigoureux?se, et tu sais gérer les pics de stress avec intelligence émotionnelle.*  **Tu maîtrises idéalement le français et l'allemand** (au minimum B1 dans la langue qui n'est pas maternelle). **Ce que nous t’offrons :**  *(Petite précision : les montants et avantages ci\-dessous sont valables pour un 100 % et seront logiquement proratisés selon ton taux d’activité !). Nous te listons ci\-dessous les avantages principaux.**  **Salaire et bonus** : on te propose un salaire fixe compris entre 4’300 CHF et 5’600 CHF bruts par mois, versé sur 13 mois. À cela s'ajoute un bonus mensuel (allant jusqu'à 10 % de ton salaire brut) directement lié aux perfs collectives du magasin. Sans oublier la participation annuelle aux bénéfices : elle n'est pas garantie, mais on se donne à fond toute l'année pour la décrocher !*  **Actionnariat** : une fois par an, tu peux devenir actionnaire de l’entreprise. C'est un excellent placement : la valeur de l'action n'a jamais été négative depuis la création de Decathlon il y a 50 ans !*  **Vacances** : parce que la récupération fait partie de la performance, tu profites de 5 semaines de vacances payées par an.*  **Passion Sport** : On soutient ta pratique à fond ! Profite de 25 % de remise sur tes achats Decathlon (et même de 25% de remise supplémentaire si tu achètes un produit de mobilité douce pour tes trajets domicile\-travail). On t’offre aussi un bon de 225 CHF/an pour ton abonnement de sport ou de fitness.*  **Ton développement** : Chez nous, tu n'arrêtes jamais d'apprendre grâce à notre centaine de formations continues. De plus, tu as un moment privilégié chaque mois avec ton/ta Leader pour discuter de tes objectifs et de tes envies. **Ta carrière : chez nous, l'évolution n'est pas un mythe** **Tu nous rejoins à l'Atelier ?**  Tu pourras devenir Responsable Atelier, évoluer vers le commerce en tant que Responsable de Rayon, ou même devenir Formateur·rice. Les possibilités sont multiples ! L'anecdote qui prouve tout : notre actuel patron de Decathlon Suisse, , a commencé chez nous quand il avait 18 ans... en tant que vendeur ! Et des histoires comme la sienne, on en a des dizaines.Avec des milliers de métiers possibles en Suisse et à l'étranger, ta trajectoire t'appartient. Rejoindre Decathlon, c'est intégrer un réseau mondial où les possibilités d'évolution sont bien réelles. **Le processus de recrutement : comment on se rencontre ?**On mise sur une évaluation objective et humaine. Voici les étapes pour nous rejoindre :1.  **Ta candidature** : Pas besoin de lettre de motivation chez nous. Envoie simplement ton CV et réponds à notre court questionnaire.2.  **L’Assessment** : Dès que tu postules, tu recevras un email d’AssessFirst (pense à bien vérifier tes spams !). C’est un questionnaire de 30 minutes maximum pour nous aider à découvrir ta personnalité et tes soft skills. Rassure\-toi, ce n'est pas une IA qui trie ton CV : ce sont bien nos équipes qui lisent chaque candidature et qui assurent la présélection ! Le vrai plus ? Tu obtiens tes résultats instantanément, un super bonus pour t'aider dans tes recherches ou tes futurs entretiens.3.  **L’échange "fit culturel" (en visio)** : Une première discussion avec l’équipe Talent Acquisition pour vérifier qu'on partage les mêmes valeurs. Tu peux retrouver celles de Decathlon4.  **L'entretien métier (en magasin)** : Rencontre ton/ta futur·e Manager pour parler concret : ton futur terrain de jeu et tes compétences techniques. (Une dernière étape avec la direction du magasin est parfois ajoutée). **Prêt·e à relever le défi ? Rejoins\-nous !** ![DECATHLON]()*** ![DECATHLON]()***jid7f32d6ejm jit1146jm jiy26jm

description: Ref 2578775 \| Date: 15 Nov 2026![Swiss Medical Network]( )Médecin Généraliste / Médecin de FamilleDescription de l'entreprise---------------------------Ancré solidement dans sa région, le **Réseau de l'Arc** est un acteur majeur des soins de proximité dans l'Arc jurassien et les régions voisines. et les modèles de soins intégrés* Capacité à travailler en équipe et en réseau interdisciplinaire* Excellentes compétences relationnelles et sens de l'écoute* Maîtrise du français indispensable : Un·e directeur·trice de travaux
=================================

Depuis 2012, ASV Construction Générale SA est active dans la direction de travaux en Valais. Membre du MBA Groupe SA, un regroupement d'entreprises spécialisées dans le domaine de la construction, nous nous engageons à offrir un service de qualité, personnalisé et à taille humaine.

 

Afin de renforcer notre équipe et d'accompagner le développement de nos projets, nous recherchons :

 

**Un·e directeur·trice de travaux**

 

**Informations clés sur le poste :**

* Type de contrat : Contrat à durée indéterminée à 100%.
* Horaire : horaires réguliers, du lundi au vendredi.
* Date d'entrée : à convenir.
* Localisation : Rue du Châble\-Bet 41, 1920 Martigny. Chantiers situés principalement en Valais.


 

**Votre mission :**

Vous pilotez l'exécution de nos chantiers, de la préparation à la remise des clés. Interlocuteur·trice de référence pour l'ensemble des intervenants, vous êtes le garant du respect des délais, des budgets et de la qualité.

Vos responsabilités principales :

* Planifier et coordonner l'ensemble des corps de métier sur vos chantiers
* Préparer les appels d'offres, analyser les soumissions et préparer les adjudications
* Assurer le suivi financier des projets : budgets, situations, avenants et décomptes finaux
* Conduire les séances de chantier et en assurer le suivi
* Veiller au respect des normes de qualité et des règles de sécurité sur site
* Organiser les réceptions d'ouvrage, les états des lieux et le suivi des retouches
* Accompagner les acquéreurs de nos promotions dans leurs choix et leurs plus\-values
* Travailler main dans la main avec les entreprises du groupe, qui réalisent une grande partie des travaux.


 

**Votre profil :**

Nous recherchons une personne structurée et autonome, capable de mener plusieurs chantiers de front sans perdre le fil et qui sait garder son calme lorsqu'un imprévu survient. Vous aimez le terrain autant que le pilotage, vous avez le sens du contact aussi bien avec le client qu'avec les sous\-traitants. Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous possédez les compétences et qualités suivantes :

Solide expérience du chantier Formation dans le domaine de la construction :

CFC du bâtiment, technicien·ne, conducteur·trice de travaux, architecte ou équivalent

* Capacité à lire et comprendre des plans
* Capacité à tenir un budget
* Sens de l'organisation
* Aisance avec l'informatique
* Excellente maitrise du français (écrit et oral)Permis de conduire indispensable


 

**Notre équipe :**

Rejoignez une équipe polyvalente et solidaire, qui avance ensemble dans une ambiance familiale, au sein d'un cadre de travail moderne et agréable. Ici, la collaboration est naturelle, les échanges sont directs et la bonne humeur fait partie du quotidien. Le professionnalisme, l'engagement et la convivialité forment l'équilibre qui caractérise notre dynamique d'équipe.

 

**Qu’est\-ce qui nous différencie ?**

Au\-delà des compétences, nous croyons que le cadre de travail joue un rôle clé dans l’épanouissement professionnel. Voici ce qui nous rend différents :

* **Esprit de proximité :** Grâce à notre organisation à taille humaine et à une gestion de proximité, nous cultivons des relations solides et authentiques au sein de nos équipes. Les échanges sont réguliers, et l’ambiance de travail reste à la fois positive et motivante. Des repas et activités d’équipe sont régulièrement organisés pour renforcer la cohésion et la convivialité au quotidien.
* **Confort et efficacité :** Nos locaux spacieux et lumineux, associés à un équipement de qualité, offrent à nos équipes des conditions de travail optimales pour rester efficaces et concentrées tout au long de la journée.
* **Nos propres promotions immobilières :** Nous ne faisons pas qu'exécuter les projets des autres. Nous développons et réalisons nos propres promotions, du terrain nu jusqu'à la remise des clés. Vous suivez donc les projets sur toute leur durée, avec une vraie latitude de décision et la satisfaction de voir aboutir ce que vous avez piloté depuis le début.
* **Nos entreprises intégrées au groupe :** maçonnerie, fenêtres et portes, carrelage, une grande partie des travaux est réalisée par nos propres équipes. Concrètement, cela signifie des décisions plus rapides, moins de dépendance aux sous\-traitants externes, et des interlocuteurs qui décrochent quand vous appelez. Une différence que l'on mesure chaque jour sur un chantier.


 

**Information importante :** Les candidatures doivent être soumises exclusivement via la plateforme Jobup et doivent contenir un CV, une lettre de motivation, les diplômes ainsi que les certificats de travail. Les dossiers envoyés par e\-mail ou par courrier ne seront pas pris en compte. En cas de difficulté technique lors de votre postulation, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter au 027 723 23 32, nous nous ferons un plaisir de vous accompagner.

Les prestations techniques et opérationnelles :*** Réaliser les prestations de réparation, d'entretien et de remise en état selon les standards de sécurité Decathlon.* Assurer la personnalisation des produits (flocage, gravure...).* Garantir l'exactitude de ton stock de pièces détachées et commander ce qu'il manque.* Veiller à maintenir un environnement de travail sûr, propre et sécurisé.* Tes indicateurs de réussite (KPIs) : Taux de réparation, Délai de traitement local, Fiabilité du stock, Efficience atelier, Croissance de la GMV sur la personnalisation et récompenses, NPS personnalisation.**Ce que nous attendons de toi :*** Tu possèdes une **formation technique (type CFC, AFP**) et une expérience prouvée en mécanique (cycle idéalement, ski/fitness un gros plus)* Tu es un?e véritable **passionné?e de sport** et tu es pratiquant?e

En parallèle, elles assurent l'administration des allocations familiales et l'application des conventions collectives de travail.Un périmètre technique exigeant, au service de milliers d'entreprises et de leurs assurés — où chaque dossier a un impact direct sur la vie professionnelle et sociale des personnes concernées.### Description du poste**Votre mission:**Vous jouez un rôle central dans l'amélioration continue des processus, l'évolution des outils métiers et la transformation digitale de nos activités. Véritable interface entre les équipes métiers et les partenaires informatiques, vous veillez à la qualité, à la conformité et à l'efficience des traitements tout en garantissant l'adéquation des solutions informatiques aux besoins des utilisateurs.**Vos responsabilités**· Expertise métier et qualité· Gérer un portefeuille des comptes individuels conformément aux directives DCACI· Analyse et traitement des contestations de comptes individuels· Reconstituer des déclarations de salaires· Rectifier les inscriptions sur les comptes individuels pour les années prescrites· ·Veiller à l'application des exigences légales, réglementaires et des directives internes.· Contribuer à la rédaction, à l'harmonisation et à l'évolution des processus et procédures métier.· Transformation digitale et gestion des outils· Assurer le rôle d'interface entre les équipes métiers, la DSI et les partenaires informatiques.· Participer à l'évolution des applications métier, à la définition des besoins, aux phases de tests, aux déploiements et aux projets de migration.· Coordonner le suivi des incidents et contribuer à la recherche de solutions adaptées aux besoins opérationnels.· Amélioration continue et accompagnement· Identifier les opportunités d'optimisation et proposer des améliorations de processus et d'outils.· Élaborer des supports utilisateurs, documentations et procédures liés aux applications métier.· Former et accompagner les collaborateurs dans l'utilisation des outils et des nouvelles fonctionnalités.· Contribuer à la mesure et au suivi de l'efficacité des améliorations mises en œuvre.· Collaboration et communication· Assurer la coordination et la circulation de l'information entre les différents acteurs internes et externes.· Participer aux groupes de travail et instances transverses en tant que référent métier.· Soutenir les équipes dans la résolution des problématiques opérationnelles et garantir une expérience de qualité pour les assurés et les affiliés.### Profil recherché**Votre profil**· CFC d'employé(e) de commerce ou formation équivalente.· Brevet fédéral de spécialiste en assurances sociales, un atout.· Expérience confirmée dans le domaine des assurances sociales.· Expérience dans la participation à des projets informatiques (tests, déploiements, évolutions d'applications ou migrations), un avantage.· Excellente maîtrise des outils informatiques et intérêt marqué pour les solutions digitales.· Très bonnes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et d'organisation. **Vos atouts**· Capacité à faire le lien entre les besoins métier et les solutions techniques.· Esprit d'amélioration continue et orientation qualité.· Aisance relationnelle et excellentes compétences de communication.· Sens du service et de la relation client, esprit d'équipe et approche collaborative.· Capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers et projets simultanément dans un environnement en évolution.· Autonomie, rigueur, force de proposition et esprit de synthèse.![Fédération des Entreprises Romandes Genève]()* Fédération des Entreprises Romandes Genève  Rue de Saint\- 98  1211 GENEVE 11*jid036e68ajm jit1146jm jiy26jm

Architecte polyvalent (h/f)
===========================

**A propos de Jouan – de Rham** 

 

Jouan –de Rham est un groupe immobilier genevois actif dans l’architecture, le conseil, le pilotage de projets,

la gérance et les transactions.

Le groupe intervient principalement sur des projets résidentiels de qualité dans le canton de Genève et la région lémanique, pour une clientèle privée et institutionnelle exigeante.

En parallèle, Jouan\-de Rham développe une activité croissante dans les aménagements de bureaux

et projets commerciaux.

 

Son organisation structurée et multidisciplinaire permet d’accompagner ses clients sur l’ensemble du cycle immobilier.

 

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous **recherchons un(e) architecte expérimenté(e)** capable d’intervenir de manière autonome sur des projets exigeants.

Ce poste offre une vision complète du projet architectural, de la phase d’étude, à la préparation de l’exécution et de son suivi.

* Développement d’avant\-projets et projets
* Coordination des mandataires spécialisés
* Préparation et suivi des demandes d’autorisation
* Élaboration des plans d’exécution
* Participation aux appels d’offres et analyses comparatives
* Coordination technique et suivi architectural des chantiers
* Relation directe avec les maîtres d’ouvrage
* Contribution aux projets d’aménagements de bureaux et fit\-out commerciaux


 

**Votre profil**

* Diplôme d’architecte EPF / HES ou équivalent
* 3 à 5 ans d’expérience en Suisse
* Expérience confirmée en projets résidentiels
* Intérêt ou expérience en aménagements de bureaux
* Maîtrise d’Archicad
* Bonne connaissance des normes SIA et des procédures administratives genevoises / vaudoise un plus
* Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle
* Autonomie, rigueur et sens des responsabilités
* Nous recherchons un profil solide techniquement, structuré et fiable, souhaitant s’inscrire durablement dans une structure en croissance.


 

**Ce que nous offrons**

 

* Intégration au sein d’un groupe immobilier établi et en développement
* Projets variés et exigeants
* Environnement professionnel structuré au sein d’une équipe jeune et dynamique
* Collaboration directe avec la direction
* Perspectives d’évolution selon l’implication et les responsabilité




**Informations complémentaires**

* Taux d’activité : 100 %
* Contrat : durée déterminée (CDD) – remplacement pour congé maternité
* Lieu de travail : Genève
* Mobilité selon les projets (permis de conduire un plus)
* Début : à convenir


Durée : à préciser selon la période de remplacement

Superviser les interventions techniques et accompagner le diagnostic des dysfonctionnements complexes. Identifier les causes des problèmes récurrents et définir les actions permettant d'en limiter les conséquences sur la production. Collaborer avec les équipes opérationnelles afin de planifier les travaux tout en limitant les interruptions d'activité. Prendre en charge des projets industriels impliquant plusieurs spécialités techniques. Organiser les différentes phases de réalisation, depuis l'analyse des besoins jusqu'à la mise en œuvre des solutions retenues. Participer aux réflexions concernant l'évolution, l'adaptation et la modernisation des équipements de production. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les départements production et méthodes pour identifier les possibilités d'amélioration. Proposer des évolutions techniques permettant d'accroître la productivité et de maîtriser les coûts d'exploitation. Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec différents départements et partenaires externes. ### Benefits \*\*Ce que vous trouverez chez notre client:\*\* Une fonction à responsabilités associant management, maintenance industrielle et gestion de projets techniques. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Kursleitung SVEB-Lehrgang und Konzeptprüfung--- Kursleitung SVEB\-Lehrgang und Konzeptprüfung==============================================Die IZYEF GmbH bereitet unter den Marken Sprachen Akademie und Sprachschule Aktiv einen Lehrgang zum SVEB\-Zertifikat Ausbilderin/Ausbilder – Durchführung von Lernveranstaltungen (AdA ZA\-DL) vor. Wir suchen eine Fachperson, die das bestehende Konzept mit uns weiterentwickelt, die fachliche Modulleitung übernimmt und selbst unterrichtet.Ihre Aufgaben-------------* Das vorhandene Kurskonzept mit den SVEB\-Vorgaben abgleichen und notwendige Anpassungen mit uns umsetzen.* Tagespläne, Lernaufträge und Unterlagen für die Kompetenznachweise fachlich prüfen und überarbeiten.* Die pädagogische Projektleitung bei fachlichen Fragen im Anerkennungsverfahren unterstützen. Ihre Funktion und Qualifikationsnachweise führen wir im Anerkennungsdossier auf.* Nach der definitiven AdA\-Anerkennung das Modul fachlich leiten, in Zürich und live online unterrichten, Teilnehmende begleiten und Kompetenznachweise beurteilen.Ihr Profil----------* Sie erfüllen das allgemeine SVEB\-Dozierendenprofil für AdA\-Module. Als Qualifikation in Erwachsenenbildung kommen zum Beispiel ein Diplom in Erwachsenenbildung HF, ein eidgenössisches Diplom als Ausbildungsleiterin oder Ausbildungsleiter oder eine Abschlusskombination gemäss SVEB\-Profil infrage.* Sie weisen mindestens fünf Jahre und mindestens 500 Stunden Praxis in der Erwachsenenbildung nach. Sie sind aktuell in diesem Bereich tätig und bringen eine abgeschlossene Erstausbildung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterbildung mit.* Sie planen und unterrichten sicher in Präsenz und live online, geben klare Rückmeldungen und verfügen über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.* Erfahrung mit SVEB\-Lehrgängen, der Ausbildung von Ausbildenden oder Anerkennungsverfahren ist von Vorteil.Zusammenarbeit und Einsatz--------------------------Die Zusammenarbeit ist im Stundenlohn oder auf Mandatsbasis möglich. Umfang, Vergütung und Termine für Konzeptarbeit, Unterricht und Beurteilung vereinbaren wir vorab.Konzeptarbeit ab Vereinbarung. Der Lehrgang ist ab 2027 geplant, vorbehaltlich der definitiven AdA\-Anerkennung. Vorgesehen sind sechs bis zwölf Teilnehmende, Präsenz in Zürich Oerlikon oder am HB und Live\-Onlineunterricht. Dienstag\- oder Samstagnachmittage sind möglich; die konkrete Planung stimmen wir mit Ihnen ab. Die pädagogische Projektleitung begleitet den Aufbau. Unsere Administration übernimmt die Kursorganisation.Ihre Bewerbung--------------Senden Sie Ihren Lebenslauf, Ihre Diplome und Weiterbildungsnachweise sowie eine Übersicht Ihrer Erwachsenenbildungspraxis mit Zeitraum, Zielgruppen und Stundenumfang an (info@sprachenakademie).Sprachen Akademie / Sprachschule Aktiv \| IZYEF GmbH  ![IZYEF GmbH]()* IZYEF GmbH  Usteristrasse 11  8001 Zürich*jida2cf72bjm jit1146jm jiy26jm
